Name: Better Beads
Author: Florain030
Description:
Better Beads / 更好的拼豆 · 1.1.0 RC6 修复更新
- 修复了一些bug
需要星露谷1.6、SMAPI 4.5.1或更新兼容版本；支持中文、英文。
更新前退出游戏，备份自定义配置、素材及 imports、exports、draft-recovery，再替换 BetterBeads 文件夹。
联机、手柄与触控做了适配，但可能还有bug。
欢迎反馈 ；喜欢的话请点个 Endorse 支持一下！
首次安装：将 BetterBeads 文件夹放入 Mods，觅食2级后向罗宾购买拼豆台配方。
操作：左键摆豆，右键擦除，滚轮缩放，中键或空格＋左键平移；Ctrl+S保存，Ctrl+Z/Y撤销重做，Home适应画布。GMCM可选。

Better Beads · 1.1.0 RC6 Fix Update
- Fixed some bugs.
Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.1 or a newer compatible version. Chinese and English included.
Exit the game before updating. Back up custom config, assets, imports, exports and draft-recovery, then replace the BetterBeads folder.
Co-op, controller and touch controls have been adapted, but bugs may remain.
Feedback is welcome! If you enjoy the mod, please leave an endorsement.
First install: Place BetterBeads in Mods. Reach Foraging level 2, then buy the workbench recipe from Robin.
Controls: Left-click draws, right-click erases, mouse wheel zooms; middle drag or Space + left drag pans. Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Home fits the canvas. GMCM is optional.
